result.note: Tested the location and diplomatic level of the October 2026 protests, and the 2019 downgrade of India–Pakistan ties; skipped the disputed accounts of the shooting.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, India and Pakistan lodged protests with each other over a shooting by India's Border Security Force on 2 October. Consider the following statements:
items: The shooting took place in the Ferozepur sector of Rajasthan.
Each government lodged its protest with the other country's high commissioner.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The Ferozepur sector is in Punjab, not Rajasthan. The protests were made to each other's chargé d'affaires, because neither country has had a high commissioner in the other's capital since 2019.
questions.source: On Saturday, each government protested to the other's chargé d'affaires over the October 2 killing of two Pakistani men by India's Border Security Force (BSF) in Punjab's Ferozepur sector.

questions.prompt: As of October 2026, since which year have India and Pakistan been without a high commissioner in each other's capitals?
questions.explain: Pakistan expelled India's envoy in 2019 after New Delhi revoked Jammu and Kashmir's special constitutional status. Since then, the two countries have dealt with each other through chargé d'affaires.
questions.source: Neither country has had a high commissioner in the other's capital since 2019, when Pakistan expelled India's envoy after New Delhi revoked Jammu and Kashmir's special constitutional status.
